notes: *that* on the article and *same* on αὐτῇ under rule 60; reading *that same* wholly as the identity pronoun's remains defensible, and LUK.10.21 analyses the parallel ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ the same way (rule 24).
παρ' carries the supplied *give* under rule 62 while αὐτῶν keeps *they*; the article keeps *such things as* under rule 32's prepositional-phrase contrast.
